描述_EN: figures with turquoise and purple glazes were particularly popular; in this ming example, guan di is depicted in martial aspect, wearing full armour. in addition to large statues placed in city's temples, smaller wooden or porcelain images of guan di were made for worship. the figure would have been placed on an altar in a household or in a temple. guan di, the god of war, is one of the most important figures in chinese mythology and popular culture. with the name guan di, he was worshipped in temples and households as the daoist god of war and patron of honest merchants. his image comes from an historical figure, guan yu (about 161-220), a general who helped liu bei to establish the shu han dynasty in ad 221. after his death, he was venerated as a loyal and righteous figure, until he was given the title of an emperor in ad 1594.
描述_ZN: figures with turquoise and purple glazes were particularly popular; in this ming example, guan di is depicted in martial aspect, wearing full armour. 除了放置在城市寺庙中的大型雕像外，还制作了较小的木质或瓷质关帝像供人崇拜。 该雕像会被放置在家庭或寺庙的祭坛上。 关帝，战神，是中国神话和流行文化中最重要的人物之一。 他被称为关帝，在寺庙和家庭中被奉为道教的战神和诚实商人的守护者。 他的形象来自于一个历史人物，关羽（约161-220），一个帮助刘备在公元221年建立蜀汉王朝的将军。 他死后，被尊为忠义之士，直到公元1594年被封为皇帝。
